note: vespera!: build files under target/vespera/ (route cache, embedded and pretty spec sidecars) are now named per invocation (crate name + hash of the macro settings) instead of per crate. A crate with several vespera! calls using different settings (e.g. a default and an admin app with their own dir/title/openapi) previously overwrote the shared cache on every expansion, so no invocation ever hit its cache and the shared embedded-spec file held whichever spec was written last. Each invocation now keeps its own cache (warm rebuilds hit) and embeds only its own spec. Single-invocation output is unchanged; the first build after upgrading regenerates the cache.
